payout_quote: And if you live in Columbia, Clatsop, Tillamook, or Lincoln Counties and earn our premium Choice Checking rate for three months in a row, we'll give you a $200 bonus!
steps: Open a new Choice Checking account at Fibre Federal Credit Union (available to residents of Columbia, Clatsop, Tillamook, or Lincoln Counties, Oregon)

Earn the premium Choice Checking rate (4.25% APY on balances up to $20,000) for three consecutive months by meeting the monthly account requirements: enroll in Online Banking, subscribe to eStatements, and meet the per-cycle debit/ACH qualifications (official TIS addendum: 12 debit card transactions of $5.00 or more each plus one direct deposit or automatic electronic payment (ACH), or Fibre/TLC credit card purchase, posting and clearing each Choice Checking cycle)
Receive the $200 bonus after qualifying for 90 days (Choice Checking cycle runs from the 25th of a month to the day before the last day of the following month)
catches: Requires qualifying for the premium Choice Checking rate three months in a row - three consecutive cycles of debit/ACH activity, not a one-time action
County-restricted: only residents of Columbia, Clatsop, Tillamook, or Lincoln Counties, Oregon
If the monthly requirements are not met, the APY drops to 0.10% and ATM fees are not refunded
Portion of balance over $20,000 earns only 0.25% APY
Business accounts are not eligible; limited to two accounts per primary member; fees may reduce earnings
The 4.25% APY rate was effective 2/23/26 and is subject to change; check the current rate before relying on it

The official TIS addendum describing the per-cycle qualification details is dated 8/1/2025 and lists only Columbia and Clatsop Counties, while the current 2026 promo page expands to Tillamook and Lincoln - confirm the current cycle details with the CU
biggest_catch: You must actively earn the premium Choice Checking rate for three straight months (monthly debit/ACH activity required) - miss a single month's qualifications and the bonus does not pay.
eligibility: Residents of Columbia, Clatsop, Tillamook, or Lincoln Counties, Oregon; new or existing members opening a Choice Checking account (per the official TIS addendum: new member, or a current/prior member with no open Choice Checking account).
timing: Must qualify for 90 days (three consecutive monthly cycles); cycles run from the 25th of one month to the day before the last day of the next month.

c3.evidence: No upfront fee; 'no monthly fees'; minimum $25 to open.

c4.evidence: Official page: 'we'll give you a $200 bonus!' for three consecutive months of premium-rate qualification; 'Must qualify for 90 days to earn $200 bonus.'
